_what: How fast Trillion feels to the person, timed in their own sessions (src/workspace/felt-speed.ts): each moment is one thing they wait for, from the moment they asked to the moment it showed. Each device keeps its last kept_samples timings of a moment on itself and writes one row per moment (and per screen, for a screen opening) to the person's own list below, at most once per write_every_seconds per row, so every AI reads what the person actually waited (read_list) beside what the proof accounts measure. A wait the page could not see to its end (the tab was put away) or could not complete (the connection was lost) is not kept; a wait past wait_most_ms is kept as wait_most_ms. budget_ms is how long it may take (the screens' budget is screen_ms in scripts/workspace-budgets.json).

list.label: How fast Trillion feels
list.about: How long you waited in your own sessions, timed on each of your devices: opening Trillion, Find anything and each screen. Typical is the middle of your last timings, slowest the slowest tenth.

fields.label: Device
fields.free_text_because: The page writes the kind of device it was waited on (phone, computer) as it measures, never typed by the person.
